[[FC Bunyodkor|Bunyodkor]] were the defending champions from the 2011 campaign. The draw for the 2012 Uzbek League season took place on January 6, 2012.„[http://pfl.uz/index.php?act=news§ion=11&subsec=5&news_id=2230 Состоялась жеребьевка Чемпионата-2012, 06.01.2012] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120129071656/http://pfl.uz/index.php?act=news§ion=11&subsec=5&news_id=2230 |date=2012-01-29 }} {{in lang|ru}}.
